thread:
maria: Heads-up — after last night's CNI bump we started seeing intermittent Redis pipeline timeouts in west2-gpu. Latency spikes + some TCP retransmits.
jonah: Confirmed. Seen across ~10 pods on the same node-pair, primarily cross-node east-west. RDMA-backed NVLink transfers also showing errors in logs.
kevin: Any immediate mitigation? Is it MTU related or a policy change?
maria: Initial tcpdump shows lots of ICMP "fragmentation needed" from intermediate vRouter. PMTU looks like it dropped to 1400 in path, but pods are still using 9000.
asha: That smells like the CNI changed encapsulation/GSO handling. Which CNI image did we roll?
maria: It was the cni image from last night's deploy: cilium:2025-03-08-alpha (merge that toggled `disable-gso` behavior).
jonah: Logs from rdma stack: `rdma_cm_event: RDMA_CM_EVENT_ADDR_ERROR` and kernel: `NETDEV WATCHDOG: vethXXXX: transmit timed out` — weird mix of fragmentation + veth timeouts.
kevin: Could be that enabling offload without adjusting `net.ipv4.ip_no_pmtu_disc` created PMTU blackholes for RDMA tunneled flows.
asha: Quick test — can someone `sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_no_pmtu_disc=1` on a noisy node and bounce affected pod to see?
maria: Doing that on node gpu-node-12 now. Also tried lowering pod MTU to 1450 via annotation; that temporarily reduced retransmits for one Redis instance.
jonah: If MTU fix helps, we should patch CNI config to set encapsulation MTU or disable the new GSO logic. Rolling rollback is an option too.
kevin: We saw the same pattern in a staging rollout last month but it was sneakier — only RDMA flows triggered an ICMP frag path. This is likely a kernel+offload interaction exposed by the CNI change.
sre-bot: incident created: #INC-20250308-redis-eastwest-pmtu (priority: P1) — runbook assigned to eng-infra oncall.
maria: Action items I'm doing: 1) revert CNI image on a canary node, 2) continue PMTU sysctl experiment, 3) collect pcap + `ethtool -k` and `ss -tin` outputs.
asha: If revert looks good on canary we should halt the rollout and publish a patch to force `GSO disable` toggle off until we test kernel interactions.
jonah: Also add a short-lived netpol to avoid cross-node RDMA for Redis until we stabilize — reduces blast radius.
kevin: FYI cost implications: some jobs are retrying and eating GPUs; any scaling we do to keep SLAs will spike spend. Notify finance if we need to pre-authorize temporary bursts.
maria: Noted. Will update incident with observed token counts and GPU job retries.
deploy-bot: rollback triggered for cilium:2025-03-08-alpha on cluster west2-gpu-canary by maria — status: in-progress.
jonah: Thanks. Once we have canary green, schedule a full rollback and open a postmortem with the CNI vendor — this one is subtle and could affect other customers.
kevin: Putting a temp runbook entry: if RDMA flows error after CNI change, set pod MTU to 1450 OR `sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_no_pmtu_disc=1` and restart pods; escalate to eng-ml if GPU jobs still fail.
maria: Will paste pcaps + `ethtool -k` outputs to the incident shortly.
asha: Thx — keeping eyes on canary. :eyes:
